bibliographic.title: The Assassination of Zurik Greybush
bibliographic.author: Scott Angeloni
bibliographic.description:
This is a standalone assassination mission of Zurik Greybush.

Zurik is a blacksmith in the Trade Discal of the Radiant Citadel who hired a group of adventures to open up a trade route for magical weapons with Wuha Algernon. The group of adventures have not returned to Zurik in almost a ten day. This is far to long for Zurik. He decides to confront the group the next time they are in town. However, this does not go as planned. He wanted to shake them up a bit so he could possible scam them out of some of their magical weapons or gold. Instead he ignites a searing flame inside one of the party members, a Monk named Grey. Grey is an assassin of The Great Xing empire.
